canonical_json: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) - keys sorted recursively by UTF-8 codepoint, no whitespace, non-ASCII NOT escaped
canonical_json_note: This generator reproduces VRT1's own published agent_action.json vector byte-for-byte (canonical bytes, action_id, pubkey, signature), so the encoding here is validated against the spec's output rather than only against itself.

files.action.json: positive vector: action, canonical bytes, action_id, Schnorr sig
files.merkle.json: leaf/node rule, single + 3-leaf batch with inclusion proof
files.nostr_1990.json: kind 1990 wrapping with the three required checks
files.source-receipt.json: the production Insight receipt these vectors are built from

normalisation_rule_5_2.test: if lowercasing loses information it is Class B

schnorr_aux_rand: 32 zero bytes. Confirmed as the VRT1 convention by reproducing the published agent_action.json signature byte-exact with it. Required to reproduce sig_hex.
uint256_encoding_5_1: decimal strings, uniformly, including small fields
